features.name: cost_code_sum
features.description: Sum of encoded buying and maintenance tiers for a compact cost-code axis.
features.expected_model_benefit: Enables simple threshold splits on combined purchase and upkeep settings.

features.name: cost_code_max
features.description: Maximum encoded tier across buying and maintenance, emphasizing the upper-range cost code.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a tree a single split point for rows where either cost component is in the upper range.

features.name: cost_code_imbalance
features.description: Absolute gap between buying and maintenance encoded tiers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures asymmetric purchase and upkeep profiles that may need separate splits.

features.name: space_code_sum
features.description: Sum of doors, seating capacity, and luggage encoded tiers as a coarse space axis.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows threshold splits for compact versus roomy configurations.

features.name: utility_code_sum
features.description: Sum of seating capacity, luggage, and safety encoded tiers as a practical-use axis.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a one-dimensional split for combined usability cues.

features.name: weakest_utility_code
features.description: Smallest encoded tier among seating capacity, luggage, and safety, representing the limiting practical-use cue.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets a tree isolate rows with any weak practical component using one threshold.

features.name: capacity_safety_interaction
features.description: Product of seating-capacity and safety codes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes nonlinear synergy between capacity and safety that a shallow tree can split directly.

features.name: capacity_safety_floor_flag
features.description: Indicator for the lowest encoded seating-capacity or safety tier.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a clean binary split for a likely hard constraint.

features.name: cost_utility_balance_code
features.description: Difference between practical-use code sum and cost-code sum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps a tree separate rows where utility codes outweigh cost codes or the reverse.

features.name: upper_cost_code_low_utility_code_flag
features.description: Indicator for upper-range buying and maintenance code sum together with lower-range seating, luggage, and safety code sum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a ready extreme-pattern split for a cross-feature interaction.

features.name: semantic_value_balance_rating
features.description: Integer ordinal rating from 0 to 4 of row-level value balance, judged from buying, maintenance, doors, seating capacity, luggage, and safety codes using only feature meanings and training-fold code ranges; higher means the tradeoff appears more favorable.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact semantic bucket that a tree can split on when several formula thresholds jointly matter.

features.name: semantic_practicality_concern_rating
features.description: Integer ordinal rating from 0 to 4 of practical concern, judged from weak-looking capacity, luggage, door, or safety cues relative to cost codes and training-fold code ranges; higher means greater concern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies an interpretable caution scale, letting a tree separate broad practical profiles before finer formula splits.
